title: autopilot.config
description: Per-project configuration for the portable /autodev, /autoship and /autopilot commands. Committed to the repo so the same command logic works in any project. Generated (and re-generatable with --reconfigure) by the first-run interview in lib/autopilot-config.sh.

version.description: Config schema version. Bump when the shape changes incompatibly.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

$comment.description: Optional free-text note (e.g. which plugin consumes this config and how to install it).

tracker.description: Issue tracker used for ticket keys and status transitions.

type.description: Tracker kind. 'none' disables all ticket handling.

mcp.description: MCP server namespace prefix that exposes the tracker (e.g. 'mcp__jira-server'). Empty/omitted when type is 'none' or the tracker is driven purely via CLI.

keyPrefix.description: Ticket / branch / commit key prefix (e.g. 'PROJ'). Empty string when the project uses no prefixed keys.

keyRequired.description: When true, a change with no tracker key is a hard stop (create-or-ask); when false, the key is optional.

shipStatus.description: Status the ticket is moved to on a fully successful ship (e.g. 'In Review'). Omitted when tracker.type is 'none'.

shipStatusVia.description: Ordered intermediate statuses the board may require before shipStatus (e.g. ['In Progress']). Empty when a direct transition exists.

git.description: Branching, merge strategy and branch-protection facts that gate the merge.

baseBranch.description: Branch PRs target and that auto-deploys (e.g. 'develop' or 'main').

branchPattern.description: Template for feature branch names. Placeholders: {key} (tracker key), {slug}.

protection.description: Autodetected from the base branch's protection (gh api repos/{o}/{r}/branches/{base}/protection).

requiredChecks.description: Status checks that must be green to merge (e.g. ['build']). Empty when none are required.

strict.description: required_status_checks.strict — when false a behind branch still merges (no forced sync).

requireThreadResolution.description: required_conversation_resolution — all review threads must be resolved to merge.

adminBypassAllowed.description: enforce_admins is OFF → --admin may bypass protection ONLY once every visible check is independently confirmed green.

commands.description: Shell commands the pipeline runs. Empty string or omitted = 'this project has no such command; skip the step'. {pkg} in testFilter is replaced with a package name.

typecheck.description: Type/compile gate that MUST pass before any commit (e.g. 'pnpm type-check'). Set '' if the project has no type-check.

testFilter.description: Targeted test template with {pkg} placeholder (e.g. 'pnpm --filter {pkg} test').

dev.description: Local dev server used to warm the app for UI QA (e.g. 'pnpm dev').

review.description: Automated PR-review gate and local reviewers.

gate.description: Automated PR reviewer. 'none' skips the review loop.

skill.description: Skill/command that drives the review loop (e.g. 'greploop'). Omitted when gate is 'none'.

passBar.description: Threshold the loop holds to (e.g. '5/5'). Free-form; interpreted by the review skill.

mention.description: Bot mention that re-triggers review when needed (e.g. '@greptileai').

localReviewers.description: Local pre-push reviewers run on the diff (e.g. ['/review', '/codex']).

deploy.description: How merging reaches an environment, and how to smoke-test it.

trigger.description: 'merge-to-base' = merging the base branch auto-deploys; 'none' = no deploy step.

autoDeploys.description: True when the deploy runs automatically off the merge (no manual step).

healthcheck.description: URL curled to confirm the environment is up (e.g. 'http://host:8080/api/health').

urls.description: Named environment URLs used by the canary (e.g. {"client":"...","admin":"..."}).

verify.description: How to confirm the merge is actually LIVE before claiming a deploy. Omit only when nothing can confirm it. NOTE: when an external builder deploys (Coolify, Vercel, Render, Fly), a green push-triggered CI run on the base branch is NOT evidence of a deploy — that builder is invisible to `gh run`, and the healthcheck keeps answering from the previous build until the swap. Configure a build-id endpoint instead.

mode.description: 'build-id' = poll buildIdUrl until it reports the merge SHA (the only honest check with an external builder); 'github-run' = the deploy IS a GitHub Actions run, so watch the push run for the merge SHA; 'none' = nothing can confirm it — canary anyway and report the deploy as UNVERIFIED. Absent: inferred as 'github-run' when deploy.trigger is 'github-action', else 'none'.

buildIdUrl.description: mode=build-id: URL returning the commit the running build was made from (e.g. 'https://app.example.com/version').

buildIdJq.description: mode=build-id: jq filter selecting the commit from that response (e.g. '.commit'). Default '.commit'.

restartedAtJq.description: mode=build-id, optional: jq filter for a process-start timestamp (e.g. '.startedAt'). Used as the fallback signal when the commit reads as unknown/empty because the build arg never arrived — a restart after the merge time then counts as deployed, and the report says so.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to poll before reporting the deploy unverified (not failed). Default 600.

docsRef.description: Human-readable pointer to the source of truth for these values (e.g. 'CLAUDE.md §Staging Server') so they can be re-derived without trusting this file.

envSecret.description: Name of the env var / CI secret holding deploy credentials (e.g. 'DEPLOY_SSH_KEY'). Never the value itself.

qa.description: Browser QA / e2e skills and video recording of the e2e run.

qaOnlySkill.description: Report-only QA skill for post-merge staging (e.g. '/qa-only').

preview.description: Local preview handed to the human at the /autodev verification gate (Step 4.8): a link they can click, landed past the login wall.

url.description: Base URL of the local dev server when it cannot be read from the server's own output (e.g. a sandbox-assigned port). May name an env var (e.g. 'http://localhost:$CONDUCTOR_PORT'), resolved at run time. Omit to always take the URL the dev server prints.

authPath.description: Dev-only route that mints a real local session (e.g. '/dev-login'), so the preview link doesn't land on a login wall the agent has no password for. Omit when the app needs no auth.

video.description: Opt-in video recording of the --e2e scenario run.

format.description: Preferred output. mp4/gif need ffmpeg; without ffmpeg the recorder keeps webm regardless.

surface.description: Where the artifact goes: 'context' = write to .context/ for the Conductor chat; 'pr-gif' = also embed a gif in the PR body; 'both'; 'none' = record but don't surface.

maxSeconds.description: Hard cap on a single scenario recording to keep artifacts small.

rules.description: Where the repo's own engineering rules and planning artifacts live. The commands defer to these instead of embedding project rules.

docs.description: Rule docs the agent must obey (e.g. ['CLAUDE.md','docs/development.md']). CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md are the primary source.

specDir.description: Where specs for large features are written (e.g. 'docs/superpowers/specs').

prTemplate.description: Path to the PR template that must be populated (e.g. '.github/pull_request_template.md').
